basis: Three retrospective studies distinguished fixed-model numerical fidelity, TF binding labels and four-construct reporter measurements.

checks.observed: Three paired keys. One run has shared source IDs within a fold, the other has disjoint declared library IDs.

checks.fixture: private aggregate replay of public MPRA inputs
checks.available: private case execution; input study GSE174534 is public
checks.observed: For 3437 common X-window pairs in held-out RNA replicate 3, using one shared vs three distinct DNA measurements changes both the observed readout and source assignment. Adding the physical input pool to the declared ancestry reveals a shared source on both sides.

scope: Compares declarations in supplied tables. Evidence of disjoint recorded measurements is scoped to the disclosed ancestry. Biological independence, authenticity and generalization require evidence beyond these checks.
